basis: the mapped world as built from its sources, before anyone's edits; the edits are kept apart (edits_kept_apart) and drawn over it

edits_kept_apart.city_world: each browser's localStorage (kerbside:city:*), or the party host's state, sent peer to peer
edits_kept_apart.exterior_edits: this browser's localStorage (kerbside:exterior-edits:v1); verified editors' on the backend (supabase/kerbside_exterior_edits.sql); published in docs/sf-corridor-exterior-edits.json
